title: 'Trolling' to Trump via Denmark: They gather signatures to … buy California -
text:
‘Reply’ to Donald Trump and his expansive aspirations for Greenland through a website that has collected more than 200,000 signatures.
“Måke Califørnia Great ægain”, is the Danish slogan that troll Donald Trump’s well -known slogan. “Buy California from Trump through the biggest campaign ever done,” the site’s creators suggest.
It all started “just to show how unreasonable was Trump’s demands for Greenland,” the French agency explained to the French Agency. Xavier Ditua a French -born who had the idea of ​​the “market”. Why does he want to buy California? For its good climate, technology companies and avocado toast, it replies. And, of course, for Disneyland, who intends to rename her “Hans Christian Andersenland” to honor the famous Danish fairy tales.
“Mickey Mouse with a Viking helmet? Yes, thank you! “
In this state, “the rule of law, the health coverage of the whole population could be implemented and a policy based on facts,” the site writes ironically denmarkification.com.
Donald Trump could well sell California as “let’s not laugh, it’s not her biggest fan,” the request continues. As for what its citizens want? “Let’s be realistic, when did the will of the citizens stopped?
By 16.30 today 216,000 people had signed the request . The goal is to gather half a million signatures.
“My contribution to President Trump is this: He stops the neo -colonial madness and I stop the campaign,” he said Ditua .
In the last 24 hours most of the visitors on the page have been from the US, Denmark and the Netherlands.
